nodes.label: Verity Design System Rules
nodes.description: Agent-facing design rules: semantic theme tokens, dark-mode legibility, bounded scrollbars, symmetrical grid layouts.

nodes.label: Semantic Theme Tokens
nodes.description: text-text-primary/secondary/tertiary and bg-surface tokens that resolve per light/dark mode.

nodes.label: Verity README
nodes.description: Next.js 16.2.10 / React 19.2.4 Factory Operating System backed by Prisma on PostgreSQL; canonical docs live under docs/.

nodes.label: Verity Platform
nodes.description: Universal operations platform for service and production businesses; multi-tenant Factory Operating System.

nodes.label: Platform Audit
nodes.description: Security/performance audit of 384 source files, 67 routes, 54 server-action modules, ~90 Prisma models, 217 tests.

nodes.label: Server Action Auth Surface
nodes.description: Every export of a "use server" module is a public POST endpoint; auth and tenant scoping must be enforced inside each action.

nodes.label: requireHqAction guard
nodes.description: Guard used by all twelve cross-tenant actions in hq.ts to restrict HQ operator access.

nodes.label: Tenant Scoping by factoryId
nodes.description: Every service-module query filters on factoryId; detail lookups use findFirst({ where: { id, factoryId } }).

nodes.label: Deploying Verity
nodes.description: Deployment guide: region co-location (bom1 next to Supabase ap-south-1), required environment variables, post-deploy verification.

nodes.label: VERITY_HQ_PHONES
nodes.description: Comma-separated operator phone numbers admitted to /verity HQ. Empty or unset admits nobody in every environment, by design.

nodes.label: JWT_SECRET
nodes.description: Required; sessions fail closed in production without it.

nodes.label: DATABASE_URL
nodes.description: Postgres connection string; keep ?pgbouncer=true&connection_limit=1 on serverless.

nodes.label: /verity HQ Console
nodes.description: Cross-tenant operator console gated on the signed-in phone number appearing in VERITY_HQ_PHONES.

nodes.label: check-hq-access script
nodes.description: npx tsx scripts/check-hq-access.ts — read-only check of whether HQ is configured on a deployment.

nodes.label: Service Modules Spec
nodes.description: Product requirements: Verity Core data model, gap analysis, service-industry modules (Sites, Tickets, Helpdesk).

nodes.label: Verity Core Data Model
nodes.description: Canonical concepts: Organizations, Users & Roles, Clients, Sites, Workforce, Assets, Work Orders, Orders, Inventory, Quality, Documents, Approvals, Attendance, Scheduling, Notifications, Reports, Billing.

nodes.label: Site
nodes.description: A physical place belonging to a client where work happens; carries the SLA response hours stamped onto tickets at creation.

nodes.label: Verity User Guide
nodes.description: Single-source user guide rendered at /guide; setup order, master data, sites, SLA semantics, modular entitlements.

nodes.label: Phone + 4-digit PIN login
nodes.description: Every person who logs in gets a phone number and a 4-digit PIN; the phone number is the username.

nodes.label: Module Entitlements
nodes.description: A workspace only shows the modules its organisation is entitled to; missing screens mean the module is off.

nodes.label: Original MasterSheetView snapshot
nodes.description: Archived client component snapshot wiring masterData and qc-templates server actions.

nodes.label: Item tree root groups snippet
nodes.description: Six root item groups (Raw Material, Semi-Finished, Finished Good, Consumable, Packaging, Trading Goods) plus domain groups.
